summary: The uncursed enlightenment potion reaches potion.c peffect_enlightenment(), but js/potion.js still refuses its POT_ENLIGHTENMENT dispatch before the effect runs. The complete source unit also includes the cursed unease/exercise path and the blessed INT/WIS adjustments. The shared zap.c do_enlightenment_effect() already has a JavaScript implementation; preserve its downstream insight.c polymorph and status/attribute gaps.

source.branch: For a cursed potion, peffect_enlightenment increments gp.potion_unkn, prints the uneasy-feeling message, and exercises Wisdom downward. For a noncursed potion, a blessed potion first increases INT and WIS with adjattrib (discarding both return values), then both blessed and uncursed potions call do_enlightenment_effect(). The selected recording takes the uncursed branch.
callers: potion.c::peffects() directly dispatches POT_ENLIGHTENMENT to peffect_enlightenment() at 1349-1351.

The recorded player path is cmd.c command-table q -> potion.c::dodrink() -> potion.c::dopotion() -> potion.c::peffects(); matching JavaScript dispatch is cmd.js::runQuaffCommand() -> potion.js::dodrink() -> potion.js::dopotion() -> potion.js::peffects().

Other production entry paths reach dopotion() from fountain.c::drinksink() and eat.c::doeat(); they may pass POT_ENLIGHTENMENT through the same peffects() dispatch. spell.c calls peffects() for SPE_* aliases, not POT_ENLIGHTENMENT.
dependencies: attrib.c::exercise() is used for the cursed Wisdom-loss branch; attrib.c::adjattrib() is used twice for blessed INT/WIS gains, and C discards each return value. Existing implementations are in js/attrib.js; preserve state and message effects and do not use the adjattrib return as data.

zap.c::do_enlightenment_effect() is the shared downstream callee for every noncursed potion. Its source order is the self-knowledge message, message-window wait, MAGICENLIGHTENMENT display, trailing subsiding line, then positive Wisdom exercise; js/zap.js already implements that order.

The shared effect delegates to insight.c::enlightenment(). js/zap.js retains note_unported('insight.c enlightenment') for polymorphed heroes; js/insight.js also keeps named refusals for unsupported status and special attribute branches. Preserve these downstream gaps unless an independently traced replay reaches them.

evidence: The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261001125731-v16.json at 452fff60d85992524c72a8282bae13a5e32a906 reports 45/46 screens and cursors, all 8692 RNG calls matched, and a stop at segment 0 step 45: “quaffing requires peffect_enlightenment()”. The immutable recipe challenges/cases/v16/wizard-quaffs-uncursed-enlightenment-potion.recipe.session.json has an uncursed enlightenment potion and the moves “ #wizwish\nuncursed potion of enlightenment\nqo”.

nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:795-808 contains the whole peffect_enlightenment() function: cursed increments potion_unkn, emits the uneasy-feeling message, and exercises A_WIS negatively; blessed adjusts A_INT then A_WIS; both noncursed branches call do_enlightenment_effect(). potion.c:1349-1351 wires POT_ENLIGHTENMENT to this function.

Production call sites are cmd.c:1809-1810 (q -> dodrink), potion.c:526-614 (dodrink -> dopotion), and potion.c:618-640 (dopotion -> peffects); js/cmd.js:3394-3395 and js/potion.js:1834-1839, 1875-1980 provide the corresponding running path. js/potion.js:1734-1735 still throws UnsupportedQuaffError for POT_ENLIGHTENMENT, which explains the measured stop before any potion effect.

nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:2525-2532 confirms the helper emits the self-knowledge line, waits for the message window, calls enlightenment(MAGICENLIGHTENMENT, ENL_GAMEINPROGRESS), emits “The feeling subsides.” and exercises Wisdom. js/zap.js:6127-6154 implements the same order. Its existing polymorphed-hero note_unported and insight.js refusals are separate downstream gaps, not the uncursed branch that first stops this recording.

A targeted search, rg -n "peffect_enlightenment|do_enlightenment_effect|potion.c" nethack-c/patches, found no patch hunks for these functions; upstream potion.c and zap.c define the compared behavior.

callerWiring: Replace the POT_ENLIGHTENMENT refusal in js/potion.js::peffects() with the full potion.c::peffect_enlightenment() behavior. The dispatch and outer quaff path are already present.

downstreamSourceDependency.status: Existing JavaScript source implementation; retain its insight.c polymorph/status/attribute gaps.

wholeFunctionBranches: Cursed potion: potion_unkn++, uneasy-feeling message, negative A_WIS exercise.
Blessed potion: adjattrib(A_INT, 1, FALSE), then adjattrib(A_WIS, 1, FALSE), then do_enlightenment_effect().
Uncursed potion: do_enlightenment_effect(); covered by this case after the refusal is ported.
